pages.title: TaffyGo | Open-source AI-native browser for Android
pages.description: TaffyGo is a free, open-source AI-native browser for Android. Block ads and trackers, browse with Taffy, and bring your own AI provider. No account needed.

pages.title: Hand Taffy an errand | TaffyGo
pages.description: One errand in TaffyGo from start to finish, in screens from a phone: you pick the pages, Taffy works in its own tabs while you watch, and the result names its sources.

pages.title: Built for phones | TaffyGo
pages.description: Back, forward, Ask Taffy and your tabs sit in one row at the bottom, and the tabs Taffy opens are grouped apart from yours.

pages.title: AI-native browser use cases: documents, forms and research | TaffyGo
pages.description: Try TaffyGo’s interactive document and banking demos: website navigation, verification handovers, local image resizing, and form approval.

pages.title: AI providers and models for Android browsing | TaffyGo
pages.description: Explore all 38 provider entries and 667 models in TaffyGo’s catalog. Search Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek and more. Connect your own key or plan.

pages.title: Chromium, Rust and on-device Python | TaffyGo
pages.description: Explore TaffyGo’s native Android interface, Chromium browser, sandboxed Rust core, and integrated on-device Python runtime.

pages.title: Contact | TaffyGo
pages.description: Report a bug or ask a question on GitHub, and report a security problem privately there. TaffyGo has no support inbox and no contact form.

pages.title: Privacy policy | TaffyGo
pages.description: TaffyGo keeps your data on your phone. Matterward Labs runs no server for it, collects nothing from the app and has no account for you to make.

pages.title: Delete your data | TaffyGo
pages.description: Matterward Labs holds no data about you, so there is nothing on our side to delete. This is how to clear what TaffyGo keeps on your phone.

pages.title: Terms of use | TaffyGo
pages.description: The terms for using TaffyGo: the source licence, what it leaves out, and the services you connect yourself.

pages.title: Open-source licences | TaffyGo
pages.description: TaffyGo's source is under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. Where to read the notices for the browser and for this website.
